correctness.rationale: The exact product fibers of an original unit have coefficient sums 1 at the identity fiber and 0 elsewhere. Tabei's geometric compression preserves each old fiber as a monochromatic class but may merge classes; transporting the original coefficients makes every new fiber a union of zero-sum classes, except the identity fiber which also contains the 1-sum anchored class. Hence the compressed product remains 1. The coordinate compression and radius bound are coefficient-independent, support sizes are preserved by injectivity, and direct finiteness of the sofic Promislow group algebra upgrades the right inverse to a two-sided inverse.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. Tabei's Remark 7.3 explicitly identifies the coefficient obstruction over F_p and leaves it untreated. Targeted searches found no prior coefficient-transport extension giving the same total-support-to-radius bound over arbitrary fields or finite-field minimum-support computability. Adjacent work on positive-characteristic units, property (U), arbitrary-field unit criteria, and direct finiteness is acknowledged and excluded from the novelty claim.

value.rationale: The result removes an explicit characteristic-two restriction in a recent effective-localization theorem without worsening its bound, and promotes global minimum-support computability from F_2 to every finite field.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, formal verification, or a guarantee of first discovery.
